tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lta ba shan 'byed yid kyi mun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

oṃ bde legs su gyur cig /gtsang bdag bde chen chos sku dang*/ / gzugs sku 'khor bcas la btud de/ /rang gzhan lam gyi lta ba yi/ /mun sel sgron me brtsam par bgyi/ /'phags tshogs bdag la skyabs mdzod cig /thar 'dod shes ldan don gnyer kun/ /grub mtha' grags pa'i rjes 'brang dang*/ / zhen phyogs 'dzin pa'i rab rib kun/ /bsal te chos la 'jug par rigs/ / chos la'ang chos tshul du ma snang*/ /lta spyod sgom pa chos kyi gzhung*/ /lta ba 'khrul na spyod pa nor/ /de nas sgom pa'ang nyams par 'gyur/ /de phyir thog mar lta ba gces/ /yod med 'brel ba dag la yod/ /lugs ldog sgrib pa zad la med/ / rgyas rtag rtag chad bden rdzun dang*/ /phan tshun 'chol ba'i sgro skur sogs/ / spangs te bden gnyis rang sar blta/ /kun rdzob bden pa rang gis stong*/ / stong yang snang ba sgyu ma'i dpe/ /'khrul yang mi bslu bden pa'i don/ /ma brtags ma dpyad blo ngor yod/ /dpyad na cung zad grub pa med/ /lugs 'byung 'gyur chen tsam la yod/ /lhun grub chos nyid thebs la med/ /rkyen gyis 'gyur phyir rtag pa min/ /rgyun dag gnas phyir chad pa'ang min/ /ngo bo stong phyir bden pa'ang min/ /rgyu rkyen nges phyir rdzun pa'ang min/ /don dam mi stong rang nyid grub/ /grub cing mi bslu bden par yod/ /yod pa de nyid ye yod yin/ /gnyug ma gshis la grub pa yin/ /mkha' stong 'od gsal kun khyab yin/ /khyab bdag ye shes chen po yin/ /tshogs gnyis tshogs ni bsags pa yin/ /dang po nyid nas sangs rgyas yin/ /thog mtha' gnyis med dbus gcig yin/ /kun la phan pa'i gang zag yin/ /gang zag mchog te rten pa'i rigs/ /de la kha cig rten pa'i rigs/ /mtha' bral dbu ma'i don dam byed/ /yod pa min zhing med pa'ang min/ /rtag pa min zhing chad pa'ang min/ /bden min rdzun pa'ang min par grags/ /don dam yod pa min na ni/ /de nyid rtogs pa'ang yod min 'byung*/

/'dod na 'dod min su yis shes/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes 'gog gam ci// rten gyi ye shes med na ni/ /brten pa'i ye shes 'phel med 'gyur/ /mthar phyin chos sku'ang med par 'gyur/ /don dam yod pa min bzhin du/ /de nyid rtogs na log shes 'gyur/ /yul de med kyang der 'dzin blo/ /'khrul pa'i rnam gzhag byas min nam/ /so so rang rig spyod yul ba/ /sgra rtog tha snyad yul ma yin/ / rnal 'byor pa 'ang blo khyad kyis/ /gong ma gong mas gnod ces gsungs/ /zhi zhing phra la blau rgyas phyir/ /don dam blau yi spyod yul min/ /blo ni kun rdzob yin 'dod gsungs/ /min na khyod kyang smra zhe na/ /bden mod 'on kyang gsung la brten/ /brten pa nged la mtshungs zhe na/ /bden te 'on te mtshungs mi mtshungs// rigs pas gnod pa 'bab mi 'bab/ /lung rnams dgongs pa yin ma yin/ / tshig rnams don dang 'brel mi 'brel/ /rigs pa can gyis dpyad na shes/ / lung rigs can gyis bkrol na shes/ /rdzogs ldan chos la gsungs na shes/ / rgyud dang mdo lung bstan na shes/ /phyogs ris med pas blta na shes/ /skal ba can gyis bsgom na shes/ /rnal 'byor can gyis mthong na shes/ /rgyud 'grel rnams su gsungs na shes/ /spyir gyi yod tsam mtha' yin na/ /khyed kyi dbu ma yod mthar thal/ /mtha' bral dbu ma yod pa'i phyir/ /'khor gsum khyed la ma song ngam/ /de yang yod pa min zhe na/ /slar yang dbu ma med mthar thal/ / mtha' dbus gang na'ang med pa'i phy-ir/ /'khor gsum de yang khyed la 'khor/ / med pa dag kyang min zhe na/ /khyed kyi med min min pa ste/ /med pa dag ni khegs ma khegs/ /khegs na med pa min par 'gyur/ /des na yod par cis mi 'gyur/ /dgag gnyis rnal ma go min nam/ /dgag pa bkag pas sgrub pa dang*/ /sgrub pa bkag pas dgag pa dag /grub pa don gyi gnas lugs dang*// mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs dag la 'byung*/ /chos de khegs kyang de min na/

/ri bong mgo la rwa khegs kyang*/ /de nyid med pa min par 'gyur/ /gal te med pa ma khegs na/ /med pa dag ni so na gnas/ /med min smra bas ci zhig bya/ /sgrub byed dam pa don med nyid/ /dbu ma dbus na med par 'gyur/ /chos de bkag pa ma yin kyang*/ /de nyid yod pa ma yin na/ /'di ltar chos 'ga' med par 'gyur/ /da dung khyod kyi dbu ma de/ /mtha' dang bral lam ma bral dpyad/ /bral na de phyir mtha' med 'gyur/ /des na med pa'i mtha' can 'gyur/ /chos de bral yang de min na/ /skyes bu skyon dang bral na yang*/ /skyon med dam pa min par 'gyur/ /nam mkha' sprin sogs bral na yang*/ /sprin med dwangs pa min par 'gyur/ /gal te mtha' dang ma bral na/ /'o na mtha' dang bcas par 'gyur/ /chos de bral ba ma yin kyang*/ /de dang ldan pa min na ni/ /skyes bu srog dang bral min kyang*/ /srog dang ldan pa min pa 'am/ /chu sogs rnyog pa bral min kyang*/ /rnyog sogs ldan pa min par 'gyur/ /bral dang ma bral brtags med na/ /'o na mtha' bral rnam gzhag 'gal/ /brjod med phyir na med mthar 'gyur/ /khyed la khungs 'dod yod mod kyang*/ /yod med bden rdzun bzang ngan sogs/ /chos 'ga' khyed kyis ma mthong na/ /gzhan gyi lta spyod 'khrul ba sogs/ /mthong de brtse ldan khyed kyis ni/ /ma bzod bzlog par 'dod min nam/ /rang gzhan dngos por smra ba sogs/ /gzhom par 'dod pa ma yin nam// gzhan gyi khas blangs gzhan dag la/ /'khor bar khyed nyid smra yin nam/ /khas blangs med par g.yo sgyu'i tshig /blo gros che la blo rkun zhing*/ /blo gros dman la brnyas par zad/ /dman par 'dod na gsung 'bur smros/ /mya ngan 'das dang srid pa kun/ /rang stong tsam du go nas ni/ /zung 'jug bde chen dbu ma la/ / rtsod cing gzhom 'dod lung rigs te/ /g.yog 'bangs khengs pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ /rje bo smad par 'dod pa 'am/ /bu ngan pha la rgol dang mtshungs/

/khrims lugs ma zhig bzang po bsten/ /yod min don de gang gis 'jog /sgrub byed tshig de mtha' rgyud chad/ /mtha' yi dbu gcig bsgrub bam ci/ /brgal na khyed kyi grub mtha' 'jig /dpyad na khyed la grub mtha' med/ /med par 'dod na grub mtha' kun/ /zhen pas ma 'dzin lce 'phrul can/ /gzhan gyi log rtog bzlog phyir na/ /rang yang log pa'i lam la 'jug /gzhan la brtse ba'i phyir yin na/ /'o na de tsam zhe sdang ci/ /shes bya 'di la rgyal ba mkhas/ /rgyal bas rdzun min bden pa gsungs/ /bden pa'i chos 'khor gsum du gsungs/ /chos 'khor dang po bden bzhi gsungs/ /des na 'gog pa'i bden pa bden/ /rgyu 'bras bden pa rtogs phyir yin/ /bar pa mtshan nyid med pa gsungs/ /des na mtha' bzhi spros bral bden/ /kun rdzob rang stong rtogs phyir yin/ /tha ma don dam nges pa gsungs/ /des na zab mo snang ba'ang bden/ /'gyur med yongs grub rtogs phyir yin/ /chos kun bden pa'ang bzhi ru phye/ /yod pa'i dbye grangs y-in pa'i phyir/ /'gog pa'i bden pa'ang yod par 'gyur/ /shes bya bden pa gnyis su bsdu/ /shes bya'i bsdus grangs yin pa'i phyir/ /don dam bden pa'ang shes byar 'gyur/ /shes bya yin na yod dam med/ /yod na don dam mtha' med grub/ /'khor gsum dag cig dngos su 'phen/ /med pa khyed kyis bsgrub mi nus/ /gal te bsgrub na log bsgrub 'gyur/ /yongs su grags pa'ang 'jig byed dang*/ /'on kyang 'khor gsum 'di yang 'khor/ /yod pa min zhes brjod pa yis/ /don de med par mi ston na/ /dbul ba'i phung po gser rnam dag /yod med dris pas yod med ces/ /smra na gser med mi shes sam/ / med pa min zhes brjod pa yis/ /chos de yod par mi ston na/ /phyug po dag la longs spyaud dag /yod med dris pas med min zhes/ /smra na nor yod mi shes sam/ /rtag min mi rtag mi ston na/

/sgra rtag mi rtag shes 'dod dam/ /rtag par 'dod pa dag la yang*/ /byas sogs rgyu mtshan sgra rtag min/ /bum sogs dpe dang bcas pa'i tshig /mi rtag ston pa ma yin nam/ /mi rtag ston par mi 'grub bam/ /rtag dang mi rtag mi 'gal lam/ /dgag bya bsgrub bya gcig nyid dam/ /tha snyad mang po 'jig lags pas/ /de 'dra ma gsung mkhas pa kun/ / thal sbyar khyed la zhu bar bgyi/ /don dam tha snyad mi mtshungs na/ /don dam yod pa 'gog pa la/ /khyod kyi tha snyad rigs pa'ang ci/ /'dus byas dngos po 'jig pa'i dpe/ /'jig med dngos la skyon mtshungs ci/ /kun rdzob rang gis stong pa'i dpe/ /don dam dag kyang stong ngam ci/ /gzu bor mnos kyi shes ldan kun/ / khyod kyi zab mo sher phyin te/ /dus gsum kun tu yod min na/ /thog ma mthar dge min par 'gyur/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum min 'gyur/ /rgyal ba sras bcas su yis bskyed/ /bskrun par gsungs pa su zhig yin/ /rang bzhin yod pa min bzhin du/ /gzhan dag bskyed na ngo mtshar che/ /'o na kun gyis kun bskyed 'gyur/ /ri bong rwas kyang bskyed par 'gyur/ /rgyu 'bras go rim 'chol bar 'gyur/ /chos de dge ba yin nam min/ /dge ba yin na yod dam med/ / yod na yod la ci zhig sdang*/ /'khor gsum dag cig 'dir yang 'khor/ /med na med las kun med pas/ /lam bden dge ba'ang med 'gyur la/ /med mtha'i phyir na'ang 'khor gsum 'khor/ /chos de dge ba min na ni/ /de nyid lung ma bstan pa 'am/ /mi dge ba ni yin par 'gyur/ /chos de dge ba min pa'i phyir/ /dam pa'i blang bya min par 'gyur/ /'phags pa'i mngon sum min par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes min par 'gyur/ /'on kyang rang sdig mi smra mod/ / mu stegs yin na ci cha yod/ /gal te de smra rna ba 'gebs/ /gnod pa mang po 'bab na yang*/ /de 'dra dag la lan mi 'debs/ /gzhan sde yin na gzhom par bya/

/khyed kyi don dam yongs grub dag /de nyid yod pa min par 'gyur/ /dge ba bden pa yin pa'i phyir/ /bden kyang yod pa min na ni/ /bden de dge ba med par thal/ /de nyid yod pa min pa'i phyir/ /rtags gsal khas blangs khyab pa grub/ /lan gyis mi bzlog thal 'gyur med/ /gal te rjes khyab med na ni/ / yod pa min yang yod 'gyur bas/ /bden pa'i ngos las yod par 'gyur/ /de nyid yod pa min pa'i phyir/ /'khor gsum 'di dag dngos min nam/ /brgya la don 'gal yod 'gyur la/ /med pa 'ga' yang mi srid pas/ /yongs grub la yang cis mi spong*/ /log na bzlog pa med na ni/ /yod kyang yod par mi 'gyur bas/ /don dam yod par mi 'gyur bas/ /don dam yod par 'gog pa la/ / sgrub byed yang dag yod mi 'gyur/ /de dag yod pa min pa'i phyir/ /'khor gsum 'di yang 'khor min nam/ /yod pa 'ga' yang mi srid phyir/ /gzhan dbang dag kyang med 'gyur bas/ /yod par 'gog byed ci zhig yod/ /thal 'gyur snga ma'ang bzlog med na/ /yod pa min kyang bden 'gyur bas/ /gtsang bdag dngos po'ang bden par thal/ /de dag yod pa min pa'i phyir/ /'khor gsum 'di yang dngos min nam/ /yod pa min kyang bden na ni/ /yod pa dag ni cis mi bden/ /des na brdzun pa mi srid pas/ /don dam yod pa'ang cis mi bden/ /med min yod pa'ang don min na/ /med la gnod pa su zhig yin/ / yod med phan tshun 'gal bas na/ /de phyir med la yod pas gnod/ /yod pa dag la'ang med pa 'gal/ /min na yod pa min na ni/ /yod pa'ang med min ma yin nam/ /min na yod pa ci zhig 'jog /'jog byed dge ba yod pa yis/ / med pa dag ni khegs pa nyid/ /des na yod med dngos su 'gal/ /khyed kyi don dam dbu ma dag /khyed nyid bden pa yin par thal/ /khyod nyid zab mo yin pa'i phyir/ /'dod na bden pa mtha' can phyir/ /bden med dbu ma 'jig par 'gyur/ /bden min dam bca' dngos su 'gal/

/zab kyang bden pa min na ni/ /rdzun pa dag cig zab 'gyur la/ /zab pa de dag zab mi 'gyur/ /bden las zab gzhan mi srid phyir/ /zab pa 'ga' yang mi srid pas/ /mtha' bral dag kyang zab mi 'gyur/ /bden pa min kyang zab na ni/ /bden pa dag ni cis mi zab/ /zab min 'ga' yang mi srid pas/ /yod pa'i dbu ma'ang zab par thal/ /bden pa zab pa min na ni/ /bden pa dag kyang bden mi 'gyur/ /zab pa bden gzhan med phyir ro/ /zab pa min kyang bden na ni/ /yod de mtha' yang bden par thal/ /de dag zab pa min pa'i phyir/ /'di dag kun kyang 'khor gsum 'grig /khyed kyi mtha' bral dbu ma ni/ /de dag rtag pa yin par thal/ /'jig med chos kyang yin pa'i phyir/ /'jig pa med kyang rtag min na/ / 'jig med de yang 'jig par thal/ /de dag rtag min chos min phyir/ /rtag pa min kyang 'jig med na/ /'jig pa 'ga' yang mi srid pas/ /rtag pa'i dngos po'ang gzhig tu med/ /rtag min rtag pa log min na/ /rtag log mi rtag ma yin nam/ /mi rtag log yang rtag min na/ /yod pa log pa med min nam/ /med pa'ang yod min ma yin 'gyur/ /med min yod pa min na ni/ /la la med kyang med min te/ /de nyid yod pa min par 'gyur/ /yod pa min pa'ang min na ni/ / rgya mtshor med pa yod med de/ /de dag med pa min par 'gyur/ /yod pa dag ni bsgrub tu med/ /med pa dag ni dgag tu med/ /rigs pa 'di ni 'gro ba la/ / dgag sgrub cung zad min par 'gyur/ /'dod na nged la ci zhig 'gegs/ /khyod rang 'dod pa ci zhig bsgrub/ /dgag sgrub ma bshig dgag sgrub can/ /yod med bar na phung gsum med/ /de phyir yod min med min gyi/ /rgol 'di spong la gang rung smros/ /mi spong 'o na gnyis min 'di/ /mu stegs the tshom zhon dang ni/ / gnyis bcas sbyor ba dag dang mtshungs/ /des na cis kyang mtha' rigs so/ / yod min med min ston pa yis/

/lung rnams mang du yod ce na/ /med yod yod na bstan tu gsol/ /yod min med min yod med min/ /gnyis ka'i bdag nyid min pa'ang min/ /mtha' bzhi las ni rnam grol ba'i/ /bde chen sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag yul bde chen chos sku de/ /kun rdzob ngo bor yod pa min/ / don dam ngo bor med pa min/ /gnyis ka'i ngo bor yod pa min/ /yod med mtha' bzhi'i skyon bral ba/ /phyag yul bde chen sku la 'dud/ /ces pa lung gis dgongs par zad/ /med pa ma yin phyag yul bshad/ /yod min phyag dag su la 'tshal/ /gang zhig yod min med min zhes/ /don dam yod pa min bzhin du/ / de nyid rtogs na log shes 'gyur/ /yod med min las gzhan du 'ang*/ /brtag par mi nus nges tshig bral/ /zhes pa'ang 'di yi 'grel par zad/ /med min so so rang gis bshad/ /yod min 'od zer snang ldan ci/ /'di la don dam tshul gyis ni/ /zhing dang skye ba khyad par med/ /'on kyang dge ba'i las byed pa'i/ /skye ba zad na zhi thob gsungs/ /brjod du med pa'i don 'di la/ /don dam bden pa'i dbang byas nas/ /skye ba med phyir skye ba dang*/ /zhi ba'i khyad par cung zad med/ /med kyang kun rdzob dbang byas nas/ /srid zad dge ba'i las byed pa'i// skye ba zad na zhi ba thob/ /ces pa lung gi dgongs par mngon/ /'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /bzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag blta/ /yang dag mthong bas rnam par grol/ /gdod nas dag pa'i chos 'di la// bsal bya'i dri ma ci yang med/ /sngar med yon tan bzhag dgos med/ /yang dag spangs rtogs mthar phyin la/ /sgro skur med par yang dag blta/ /yid bzhin mthong na rnam par grol/ /'jig rten khams dang don dam dag

/gcig dang tha dad mtshan nyid bral/ /gcig dang tha dad gang rtogs pa/ /tshul min lta ba zhugs gsungs pa'ang*/ /'jig rten kun rdzob bden pa dang*/ /don dam 'jig rten 'das pa dag /bzang ngan yod phyir gcig ma yin/ /kun rdzob stong phyir tha dad min/ /gcig dang tha dad gang rtogs pa/ /tshul min log ltar zhugs pa yin/ /zhes pa'ang lung gi dgongs par zad/ /gzhan yang 'di 'dra'i rigs can 'ga'/ /'di dag rigs pas bkrol bar bya/ /tshig gi sbu ba'i lung nang du/ /don gyi dngos po bcug nas ni/ /'khrul ba'i the gus ma 'chings pa/ / blo yi pad+mo'i kha phye la/ /lung don ze 'bru gsal bar mdzod/ /gtsang rtag lhun grub don dam dang*/ /gsog gsob sgyu ma kun rdzob dag /mnyam nyid 'dod pa 'di 'dra ni/ /gnam sa gcig tu bsdebs pa 'am/ /dug dang sman bsre dag dang mtshungs/ /sgro skur ma byed gsung ngo kun/ /dpyad nas cung zad ma grub pas/ / kun rdzob dag ni yod 'dod la/ /so so rang rig don dam dag /yod min pa yi grub mtha' dag /rje khol go sa brjes pa 'am/ /lus po mgo gshams bzlog dang mtshungs/ /bstan pa ma dkrugs bstan 'dzin kun/ /yod pa bde gshegs snying po de/ /rang re kun gyi sa mkhan dang*/ /bkrongs pa med mod zhe la sdang*/ / zungs shig sgoms shig spongs shig sogs/ /dang po spyod pa'i don du bstan/ / med do yin no mtha' bral sogs/ /bar ba sgom pa'i don du bstan/ /yod do med do rtag chad sogs/ /lta ba shan 'byed don du gsungs/ /yod do rtag go gtsang ngo sogs/ /tha ma 'bras bu'i don du bstan/ /'bras med ma yin gzhi 'bras gsungs/ /lam kun 'bras bu yod min na/ /lam bsgrub dam pa du ma yang*/ /'bras med rgyu la 'bad dam kye/ /'bras bu yod na min pa 'gal/ /de min 'gog pa po min na/ /'gog yod min na spangs pa 'gal/ /skyon rnams spangs pa yod min nam/ /gnyen po yon tan skye mi srid/

/srid na skyon spangs ngal ba 'khrul/ /spangs rtogs mthar phyin yod min na/ /sangs rgyas dag kyang ji ltar yod/ /kun mkhyen yod pa ma yin na/ /kun gyi skyabs dang dpang po su// yod min dag gis skyon gyi ni/ /skyabs med skyabs ni tshol ba yi/ /skyabs dag ma rnyed gong du yang*/ /skyabs yod min te med pa'i phyir/ /skyabs tshol ngal bas ci zhig bya/ /'bras bu yin kyang yod min na/ /gzugs sku dag kyang yod min la/ /'bras bu kun kyang yod min na/ /sdig 'bras sdug bsngal nges pa'ang ci/ / yod m-in 'bras bur grub na ni/ /yon tan bsgrub pa'i skye bo yis/ /'bras bu yon tan ma grub po/ /yon tan yod pa med pa'i phyir/ /yon tan bsgrub ngal ci zhig bya/ /slar yang yon tan mi bsgrubs na/ /nor med skye bos nor bsgrubs pa/ /'bad rtsol ma bslabs gong du yang*/ /'bras bu nor yod min la yod/ / nor sgrub rtsol bas ci zhig bya/ /sdig spyod skye ba dag la 'ang*/ /'gog bden yod yin de yod phyir/ /des kyang 'gog pa 'grub 'gyur ram/ /'bras kun rnam dag gnyis su nges/ /skyed 'bras sngar med gsar du byas/ /bral 'bras sngar yod gsar ma byas/ /de phyir 'bras kun yod par 'gyur/ /yod pa min na 'bras bu min/ /'bras bu yin na med pa min/ /'bras bu la la yod min nam// la la yod pa min na ni/ /rgyu rkyen la la nus med la/ /la la nus dang bcas par 'gyur/ /'di yod phyir na 'di 'byung zhes/ /rgyu 'bras nges dang brdzun par 'gyur/ /mi brdzun rgyu rkyen nus mnyam la/ /'bras bu skyes mnyam rten 'brel che/ /gzhi ni chos nyid rgyu de la/ /lam bden rkyen gyis gsal bya ste/ /'bras bu bde 'byung rten 'brel che/ /gzhi la 'bras yod min na ni/ /mkhyen pa gsum yang yod min mtshungs/ /rnam mkhyen yod pa min na ni/ /rang 'bras 'phags bzhi su yis bskyed/ /yod med rnam pa su yis gzhal/

/lam dag shes pas ci zhig bya/ /gzhi dag shes pa'ang su yis mthong*/ /chos rnams kun gyi rten yin phyir/ /'gog bden chos nyid yod par 'gyur/ /kun gyi rgyu rkyen min zhe na/ / mdo mchog gser 'od dam par yang*/ /chos skur brten nas longs sku 'byung*// de la sprul pa 'phro zhes gsungs/ /nga las 'gro ba thams cad 'byung*/ /nga yis 'di kun khyab pa ste/ /'gro ba'i rang bzhin gzhan ma mthong*/ /zhes gsungs rgyud rgyal gzhan la yang*/ /byed pa sems can kun don byed/ /phan 'dogs sems can mnyes gshin pa/ /sna tshogs gzugs can bskyed pa po/ /theg pa mchog gsum ston pa po/ /kun rdzob ma yin rgyud rgyal der/ /don dam mtshan brjod ma gsungs sam/ /rdzogs ldan chos la tho ma 'tshams/ /khyed kyi zab mo stong pa de/ /nam mkha' dag dang mtshungs mi mtshungs/ /mtshungs na mkha' spyod phyir te yod/ /mi mtshungs stong pa min pa'i phyir/ /chos de dngos po yin par 'gyur/ /nam mkha' dag kyang yod min na/ /sa sogs 'byung ba brten pa ci/ / gzhan dag rten phyir mkha' yod 'gyur/ /de mtshungs chos kyang yod par 'gyur// yod pa skyon min yod 'dzin skyon/ /rtag pa skyon min rtag 'dzin skyon/ /dngos po skyon min dngos 'dzin skyon/ /snang ba skyon min zhen pa skyon/ /snang ba thams cad skyon na ni/ /med pa thams cad khegs mi srid/ /des na zhen pa khegs par ram/ /gser min gser du 'dzin na skyon/ /gser legs shes pas ci zhig skyon/ /zas min dug ni zos na skyon/ /zas mchog zos pas ci zhig skyon/ / gnyen min dgra dang phrad na skyon/ /gnyen dang phrad na ci zhig skyon/ /mi min tho yor mir 'dzin skyon/ /mi dngos mthong na ci zhig skyon/ /bden min brdzun pa mthong na skyon/ /bden pa mthong na ci zhig skyon/ /skyabs min 'dre la skyabs na skyon/ /skyabs mchog bsten pas ci zhig skyon/ /bdag min bdag tu 'dzin na skyon/

/bdag mchog rtogs pas ci zhig skyon/ /bdag rang yod pa min zhe na/ / yod mod 'gro ba'i bdag po ni/ /rgyud kun gyi ni bdag po'i mchog /khyab bdag ye shes lnga yi bdag /sangs rgyas lnga bdag cod pan can/ /gcig pu sra mkhreg rdo rje'i bdag /skyes ma thag tu 'gro ba'i bdag /nam mkha'i bdag po sna tshogs ston/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag dngos po mchog /de bzhin nyid bdag dag pa'i bdag /mi g.yo rab tu dang ba'i bdag /shes dang shes bya'i bdag po mchog /gtso bo chos kyi sbyin bdag ste/ /zhes gsungs rgyud 'grel gzhan du yang*/ /'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga*/ /rang gi tshogs ldan nyan pa nga*/ /'jig rten ston pa bsgrub bya nga*/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa nga*/ /lhan cig skyes bdag rang bzhin nga*/ /nga zhes gsungs pa'i nga bdag min/ /bdag rnams gsungs pa'ang bdag min na/ /tshig kun dgongs pa gang zhig yin/ /bdag ni yod pa ma yin na/ /'gro rnams mgo bcad mi bzhin gsungs/ /gzhan bdag mchog tu gsungs pa yi/ /mdo rgyud rnams su gzigs lags mod/ /ma gzigs na ni gzigs su gsol/ /gzigs na don la dgongs su gsol/ / gsungs pa drang don yin zhe na/ /'chugs med yin pa'i sgrub byed cing*/ /rgyud sder gsungs pa drang don la/ /de bas nges pa yod na mtshar/ /yang na drang don ci zhig skyon/ /rgyal bas ji snyed gsungs pa kun/ /gzhan gyi shes bya nyer lnga ru/ /'gro ba drang phyir don min nam/ /'jig rten pa la ma bstan par/ /kun 'byung ba ni mi sems pas/ /wā ra ṇā sīr song nas su/ /ngas ni chos 'khor bskor zhes gsungs/ /brjod de tshig kun drang don tsam/ /brjod bya don gnas nges don yin/ /yang na drang don nges don dag /ltos te ltos te nges min nam// zhi bas lam nges 'gog pa nges/ /theg pa gsum nges 'byung ba la/ /theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas/ /gnas par gsungs pa'ang bya min nam/ /'dus ma byas kyi dngos po brgyad/

/gsungs shing yongs grub dgu yang gsungs/ / dngos por gsungs kyang dngos min zhing*/ /'grub par gsungs kyang 'grub min nas/ /gsungs pa phal cher brdzun par 'gyur/ /lung brjod byas kyang stong par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba brdzun pa gsungs na ni/ /bslu med skyabs gnas gang na bgyi/ /bden pa 'ba' zhig gsungs pa na/ /de phyir kun la yang ba nyid/ /gal te bdag cig yod na ni/ /phyi rol gzhan dag bdag 'dod pa/ /ji ltar dgag par bgyi zhe na/ /bden te 'on kyang mi mtshungs mod/ /rnam sems phung po bdag dang ni/ /phung po bdag dang bdag gi bar/ /'khrul te bdag 'dod 'byung min nam/ /phung po bdag gzhan bden brdzun brtag /gzhan gyi shes bya nyer lnga ru/ /kha tshon gcod sogs 'khrul brnyan brtags/ /bdag gis shes rig skyes bu la/ /'gal ba'i skyon kun yod med brtag /bdag nyid kun tu khyab na ni/ /bdag gis yod pa gzhan dag tu/ /phung sogs sdug bsngal ji ltar dgos/ /bdag nyid rtag pa gcig pu la/ /bde sdug la sogs rkyen rnams kyis/ /rnam pa ma rnyed ji ltar 'thad/ /bdag nyid shes rig skyes la 'ang*/ / gnyid rmongs 'khrul ba la sogs kyis/ /bslus shing 'gyod sogs ji ltar 'thad/ /skyon dag gzhan yang mang yod kyang*/ /de min bdag mchog gzhan la ni/ /gnod pa'i skyon dag ci zhig bya/ /bdag min sgrub byed ci zhig mthong*/ / dngos po 'gyur sogs ci zhig mthong*/ /skye ba mthong ngam 'jig pa mthong*/ / 'phel ba mthong ngam 'grib pa mthong*/ /byung ba mthong ngam song ba mthong*/ / dar ba mthong ngam rgud pa mthong*/ /dngos su sangs rgyas grub mtha' la/ / 'gog byed gnod byed ci zhig nus/ /nus na sangs rgyas mkhas mi 'gyur/ / rjes 'jug rnams kyang 'khrul bar 'gyur/ /de phyir zhen pa de mi khegs/ / gzugs rnams stong pa stong pa'i gzugs/ /gzugs las stong pa gzhan ma yin/ /stong pa nyid las gzhan ma yin/ /gzugs sogs rnams las yod pa min/

/stong pa de dang dbyer med phyir/ /des na stong pa don min na/ /don dam bden pa stong pa min/ /stong tsam don dam yin na ni/ /kun rdzob kun kyang don dam 'gyur/ /stong tsam kun la yod pa'i phyir/ /bden kyang stong pa yin na ni/ / stong phyir ngo bo yod min 'gyur/ /ngo bo med na don dam 'gal/ /de phyir yod na'ang bden pa nyid/ /bden pa dag kyang yod pa nyid/ /yod pa min na bden pa nyid/ /yod las bden pa gzhan med phyir/ /bden pa min na yod pa min/ / bden las yod pa gzhan med phyir/ /rten gyi chos nyid zab mo dag /rgyu la yod min 'gro ba kun/ /sdug bsngal sogs kyis gdung bya'i phyir/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan min zhe na/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan gzugs sku yang*/ /'gro la thugs rjes gzigs bzhin du/ /'gro kun skyabs med gdung ba ci/ /zas sogs sa steng gnas bzhin du/ /yi dwags zas med bkres sam ci/ /grang ba sel nus nyi ma dag /mthong ba'i nam mkhar yod bzhin du/ /skyes bu yongs su 'khyag pa ni/ / nad dag sel nus sman kun dang*/ /sman pa mkhas pa sngas mgo na/ /yod bzhin nad pa shi ba ci/ /dbul bo'i phug gi sa 'og na/ /gter dag yod bzhin dbul ba ci/ /lha yi rgyal pos char phab kyang*/ /sa bon mi rung mi 'khrungs ltar/ / sangs rgyas rnams ni byon gyur kyang*/ /skal ba med pas bzang mi myong*/ /dad pa med pa'i mi dag la/ /dkar po'i chos rnams mi 'byung ste/ /sa bon me yis tshig pa la/ /myu gu sngon po mi 'byung bzhin/ /zhes gsungs rgyud rgyal dag tu 'ang*/ / sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs/ / zhes pa la sogs 'byung min nam/ /ma gsung ma gsung skyes bu kun/ /legs par rtogs te dgongs par zhu/ /smra zhing nyams su len par mdzod/ /long ste yongs su bkral bar mdzod/ /lta ba shan 'byed yid kyi mun sel zhes bya ba/ / gangs can khrod 'dir thams cad mkhyen par grags pa yi/

/shes rab rgyal mtshan bdag gis legs par bkod pa yin/ /dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas myur du thob par shog/ // ༈ shes dang shes bya ma lus thams cad kun/ /rab rib dri mas ma bsgribs thams cad mkhyen/ /rgyal ba ston pa'i mtshan bzhin gsol nas ni/ / mtshan mchog 'gro ba kun gyis thos tsam grol/ /dpal ldan bla ma kun mkhyen khyed kyis ni/ /bzang zab gzhan stong zab mo bskyangs nas ni/ /bod yul la sogs sa steng lta ngan kun/ /myur du bsal mdzad khyed la spyi bos 'dud/ / rigs ldan spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul sku khyed/ /bod yul dbang rtul sems can rnams la ni/ /lhag par thugs brtses dug gsum sel mdzad pa'i/ /nyon mongs nad sel kun mkhyen khyed la 'dud/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos 'khor rim pa gsum/ /ston pa'i ji ltar dgongs bzhin 'gro la gsungs/ /'gro rnams myur du thar pa'i lam du bkod/ /thar pa'i lam ston kun mkhyen khyed la 'dud/ /'ga' zhig sems la drag po'i bdud zhugs nas/ /nges don zab mo rnams ni chos min smra/ /skyabs grol khyed la ma dad log lta bskyed/ /rgyal sras 'phags pa'i tshogs la bskur ba btab/ /sgo gsum bdud kyi dbang du shor ba rnams/ /kun mkhyen khyed kyis myur du sgrol bar shog/ //sarba maṅga laṃ/ mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ dol po pa shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi gsung*/ lta ba shan 'byed yid kyi mun sel/ PAGE 158- PAGE 159 -- PAGE 143 -
